material_family: CsM3Pn5 kagome metals (M = Ti, V, Cr; Pn = Sb, Bi), nonmagnetic PBE (Quantum ESPRESSO 7.1, no spin-orbit coupling), Wannier90 models of 33 orbitals per cell
source: Zenodo record 17951035 (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.17951035, CC BY 4.0), S. Enzner and G. Sangiovanni, "135 Kagome Wannier Hamiltonians"

staged_files.archive: /app/archive/<model>/: Fermi_level.dat, turn_*.win, turn_*.wout, turn_*_bands.dat.gnu (DFT bands), unchanged from the record; /app/archive/DFT/: the record's example QE input scf.in and output scf.out (per-k eigenvalue listing removed; pseudopotentials, rel.in/rel.out and the Wannier band files turn_*_band.dat not staged)
staged_files.models: /app/models/<model>.npz: the archived turn_*_hr.dat converted losslessly to numpy: R (n_R, 3) lattice vectors in units of the cell of the .wout, degen (n_R,) Wigner-Seitz degeneracies, H (n_R, 33, 33) complex hoppings H_mn(R) = <m,0|H|n,R> in eV on the absolute energy scale of the archive (H(k) = sum_R exp(2 pi i k.R) H(R) / degen(R)).

format.model: TiSb | VSb | CrSb | TiBi | CrBi | CrBi_9.2
format.electrons: electrons per cell in the 33-orbital model, both spins (26-36)

ssmf.returns: metallic_solution; if true, Z and occupation per spin for Wannier functions 1-15 (the d orbitals) and the chemical potential (eV, absolute scale of the model)

slave_spin_method.correlated_orbitals: Wannier functions 1-15 (5 d orbitals on each of the 3 transition-metal sites); all other orbitals are uncorrelated
slave_spin_method.interaction: density-density Kanamori: U n_up n_dn per orbital, U - 2J between opposite spins in different orbitals, U - 3J between equal spins in different orbitals
slave_spin_method.solution: Z2 slave-spin mean field (paramagnetic, T = 0, 10 meV Fermi smearing, 9x9x6 k mesh); the metallic solution is followed continuously from weak coupling (U ramped at fixed J/U); the three transition-metal sites are symmetry-equivalent
slave_spin_method.Z: quasiparticle weight of each d Wannier function (1 = uncorrelated, 0 = Mott localized)
